query: 'SELECT
    CASE s.codigo_compacto
        WHEN 'C50911'   THEN 'C50.911'
        WHEN 'E119'     THEN 'E11.9'
        WHEN 'F329'     THEN 'F32.9'
        WHEN 'I10'      THEN 'I10'
        WHEN 'J45909'   THEN 'J45.909'
        WHEN 'K219'     THEN 'K21.9'
        WHEN 'M545'     THEN 'M54.5'
        WHEN 'N390'     THEN 'N39.0'
        WHEN 'R51'      THEN 'R51'
        WHEN 'S72001A'  THEN 'S72.001A'
        ELSE s.codigo_compacto
    END AS codigo_icd,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(MAX(s.diagnosis_description), ''), 'Sin descripcion') AS descripcion_patologia,
    CASE LOWER(COALESCE(NULLIF(MAX(s.severity), ''), 'no especificado'))
        WHEN 'mild'     THEN 'Mild'
        WHEN 'moderate' THEN 'Moderate'
        WHEN 'severe'   THEN 'Severe'
        WHEN 'critical' THEN 'Critical'
        ELSE 'No especificado'
    END AS nivel_severidad
FROM (
    SELECT
        UPPER(REPLACE(REPLACE(TRIM(sp.value), '-', ''), '.', '')) AS codigo_compacto,
        TRIM(d.diagnosis_description) AS diagnosis_description,
        TRIM(d.severity) AS severity
    FROM silver.diagnoses d
    CROSS APPLY STRING_SPLIT(d.icd_code, ',') sp
    WHERE d.icd_code IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(sp.value) <> ''
) s
GROUP BY s.codigo_compacto',
